To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
QR codes are a very promising technology that can be used in a variety of applications, however, the security and usability of QR codes has to be improved.
QR codes are vulnerable against various attack types, which can be used to deceive users, and the research challenges for usable security and security-awareness have to be tackled.

QR codes can be used in many different ways, that many attacks have been reported and that usable security and security-awareness are the most relevant challenges for the future research in the field of QR code security.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a holistic approach to the security of QR codes.
the identification of security and privacy threats in the use of QR codes, and the analysis of the state of the art in the field of QR code security and usable security.
the security of the QR code as a medium for information exchange, the security of the reader application and the security of the interaction between user and QR code.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no conclusive statement on the security of QR codes.
QR codes are neither usable nor secure.
QR codes are not inherently insecure, but that their security is not yet fully explored.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
QR code security is a very young research field with great potential.
QR code security is an emerging research area and that there are many open challenges to be addressed.
QR codes are a very promising technology that has not yet been exploited to its full potential.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the usability of security features is a key factor to make QR codes secure in practice.
QR code based attacks are a real threat to the user and the security of his/her device, but there is little to no research on the topic.
the usability of QR codes is a crucial factor that needs to be taken into account in the design of secure QR code applications.
